_doc: RI-012 fixture. Inbound Anthropic history contains an assistant tool_use without a matching user tool_result on the next turn — typical when the conversation was truncated mid-tool-call. XLI must STILL emit the FunctionCall on translate so downstream /responses receives the assistant's commitment; no synthetic FunctionCallOutput is fabricated (that would be a contract violation — the assistant didn't actually receive a result). Pairing is the model's job on the next inference turn, not the harness's. The fixture locks XLI's pass-through-the-orphan behavior.
